body:
All third-party code should be referenced in [COPYRIGHT.txt](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/master/COPYRIGHT.txt) and [README.md](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/master/thirdparty/README.md) and only include files that are actually used (+license file), not the whole 7-zip source tree.

While compression might be useful in some cases, applying it to everything will likely result in unnecessary load time increase without any benefits, so it should be done on selected files only (probably like it is done with encryption, but will require UI improvement).

If LZMA library code is added, it probably should be also supported by `FileAccessCompressed`. But not sure if there's need for LZMA at all, existing ZLIB code that is already in the engine should be sufficient for most uses.

I have not tested or checked actual compression/decompression code.
